title: Slim's family and hometown of Hollandale
summary: Slim's mother was dead and his grandmother raised him; Stovall played Hollandale and mailed her money each month.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Do you know anything about his family?
I met his family in Hollandale, Mississippi. That's where his hometown. We used to play that all the time.
Where would you play in Hollandale? At this hometown?
Yeah. Why we played there? We played there because he wanted to go home after he had got famous.
He would want to go there periodically? Yeah, to play. To play.

And of course he drew a packed house. He drew all the time around, because all of them knew him around there. So we played there several times. And if I'm not mistaken, I think we played there on our way to Memphis. I'm almost sure we're there. If we're in Nashville, I'm almost sure we're there. That was pretty long ago. Uh-huh. So I think we played that time. And we played there. I met his mother was dead. His grandmother raised her. Uh-huh. Do you remember her name? Huh? I don't remember her name. I really don't. But I met her and she told me what's happening and said, you know, he'd never send her no money. And from that day on until I got rid of him, I used to mail her money out every Saturday, each year a month. I mail her check each month. So how her name? Yeah. But I can't tell you her name. I don't remember.
It's been quite some time, you know. Was it Jones or what? Do you think it was? I don't remember. Did he have any brothers or sisters?
